title: Fixed Amount of Excise Duty PVC Wires and Cables Rules 1995

sections.shortTitle: Fixed Amount of Excise Duty PVC Wires and Cables Rules 1995
sections.section: RULE - Fixed Amount of Excise Duty (PVC Wires and Cables) Rules 1995
sections.description:
FIXED AMOUNT OF EXCISE DUTY (PVC WIRES AND CABLES) RULES
FIXED AMOUNT OF EXCISE DUTY (PVC WIRES AND CABLES)
RULES. 1995
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 6th July,
1995]
S.R.O. 646(1)/95, dated 3‑7‑1995.‑‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (8) of section 3 of the Central
Excises Act, 1944 (I of 1944), read with section 37 thereof, the Central Board
of Revenue, with the prior approval of the Federal Government, is pleased to
make the following rules for the levy and collection of fixed amount of duty on
the basis of extruders used for the manufacture of PVC wires and cables, in
lieu of the duty of excise leviable on wires and cables under subsection (1) of
the said section, namely:‑‑
1. Short title, commencement and application.‑‑‑(1)
These rules may. be called the Fixed Amount of Excise Duty (PVC Wires and
Cables) Rules, 1995.
(2) They shall come into force at once and unless earlier
rescinded shall remain in force till the end of the financial year 1995‑96.
(3) They shall apply to those manufacturers who
manufactures only PVC wires and cables having cross sectional area not more
than 8 mm' used for domestic purposes with the help of domestically fabricated
extruders and does not employ more than eight labourers including himself and
his dependents in the factory and elects for application of these rules as
provided in rule 3.
2. Interpretation. ‑‑‑In these rules,
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context, the words, and
expressions used but not defined herein shall have the same meaning as in the
Central Excises Act, 1944 (I of 1944), and the rules made thereunder.
3. Declaration to be made.‑‑‑The
manufacturer who elects to pay duty under these rules for the year 1995‑96
shall apply to that effect in writing to the Superintendent of jurisdiction by
the 15th July, 1995, declaring the number of extruders installed in his factory
and shall pay excise duty at the rate of six thousand three hundred rupees per
extruder per month on all the extruders installed in the factory irrespective
of whether or not any extruder is working or is not in working condition.
4. Option to be irrevocable. ‑‑‑The
option exercised under rule 3 shall be irrevocable for the financial year 1995‑96.
5. Amount of duty and date of payment.‑‑(1)
The amount of duty shall be paid by the manufacturer by the 25th day of each
month in advance and duty for July and August 1995, shall be paid before the
25th July, 1995.
(2) If the duty is not paid by the date, the manufacturer
shall, without prejudice to any other penal action which may be taken under the
Central Excises Act, 1944, or the rules
framed thereunder be liable to pay an additional duty in terms of section 3B of
the said Act.
6. Removal and addition.‑‑‑(1) A
manufacturer may replace an extruder installed in the factory after giving at
least ten days, advance notice to concerned Superintendent and Assistant
Collector and the extruder (to be replaced), installed in the factory shall be
dismantled before any action is taken to instal a new extruder.
(2) If during the course of the financial year, the
manufacturer installs an additional extruder in his factory, he shall pay duty
thereon from the beginning of the month in which the additional extruder is
installed. For installing, additional extruder, the manufacturer shall give at
least ten days advance notice to the Superintendent and the Assistant
Collector.
7. Abatement not allowed.‑‑‑(1) No
abatement of duty shall be admissible if any extruder is removed from the
factory.
(2) No abatement, rebate or remission of excise duty shall
be allowed on any account whatever including that on account of export under
rule 12 or rule 13 of the Central Excise Rules, 1944.
8. Maintenance of record not required.‑‑‑The
manufacturer electing to pay duty under these Rules shall not be required to
maintain any central excise record pertaining tp production or clearance of
goods.
9. Penalty.‑‑‑If a manufacturer makes a
